title: crypto.createCipher was removed in Node 22: use createCipheriv with a real key and IV

problem.symptom: TypeError: crypto.createCipher is not a function
problem.description: createCipher derived keys insecurely (MD5, no salt) and was removed in Node 22. Old ciphertexts need the legacy EVP_BytesToKey derivation to decrypt; new data should use scrypt + random IV.

limitations.proves: Round trip works, ciphertexts are randomized, and a wrong password fails.
limitations.does_not_prove: Decrypting data produced by the old createCipher (needs EVP_BytesToKey; not included).
